provenance: Every (psnr, sonar_r) pair here is a previously-reported number from this project's own session logs/memory, one entry per distinct pipeline recipe (near-duplicate reruns of the identical config collapsed to one entry to avoid pseudoreplication -- e.g. mast3r_texconf_gated has two genuinely different iteration-count variants (7k, 30k) kept as separate entries, but not multiple same-config reseeds). sonar_r is the TEST-split (held-out) correlation wherever a train/test split was reported for that model, else the combined-set number for older pre-holdout-protocol entries -- flagged as a methodology caveat, not hidden, in PSNR_VS_SONAR_RANK_CORRELATION.md.
